# MongoDB compound index design: ESR, selectivity, covering and multikey bounds — concept pack

> A compound index stores references ordered by several fields; key order (equality fields first, then sort, then range — the ESR guideline), selectivity, prefix rules, covered queries, multikey index bounds with $elemMatch and partial/sparse filter semantics decide whether a query can use the index and how many keys and documents it examines. Compiled from MongoDB manual and Atlas pages plus the run's verified claims.
